content:
Pluribus premiered on Apple TV+ last year to enthusiastic reception. Series creator Vince Gilligan recently offered exciting updates on the progress of Pluribus Season 2 and its potential return timeline.

Pluribus Season 2 is set to begin filming soon and is expected to premiere by the end of 2027

Pluribus creator Vince Gilligan appeared on Deadline's Crew Call podcast this week. The episode focused primarily on the show's music, with composer Dave Porter also a guest.

However, the conversation quickly shifted to Pluribus Season 2, with Gilligan sharing several important updates.

Here's what he had to say:

It remains unclear exactly when the interview was recorded. Therefore, his mention of filming starting "in a few months" could mean as early as September. Either way, getting into production this quickly is an encouraging sign.

Following these comments, Gilligan was pressed on whether he "still believes" Season 2 will premiere by the end of 2027.

This question is intriguing because it presupposes that Gilligan had previously set a timeline of late 2027. To my knowledge, he has never publicly stated such a target. Gilligan sidestepped the question with humor, joking that it would be "sometime within the 21st century".

Given that filming is expected to last approximately six months, late 2027 is a very reasonable timeframe. Apple undoubtedly wants the show to debut in the same window as Season 1, so a November 2027 premiere would be the target.

Among other notable details from the podcast, Gilligan stated his plan for Pluribus to run at least three seasons, and possibly four. He then admitted that his original plan for Breaking Bad was also just a few seasons, before being extended significantly, so Pluribus could likewise change at any point.
